parsed.post: Discarding the 1.035100 run; it was a slight regression from my 1.032403 best. I'll move away from the 0.03 LR experiment for a moment and try increasing the learning rate to 0.04 to see if we can squeeze more convergence out of the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.04 on the previous best configuration to attempt faster convergence.
